The correct response is not to appeal, not to find a workaround, and not to use a friend's account in another country. The correct response is to build infrastructure that does not depend on their permission to operate. [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-what-actually-5|COREMERCH guide to cloudflare]] Pages serves your storefront. NOWPayments verifies payments on-chain and fires a webhook the moment a transaction confirms. Your backend processes the order and delivers the product automatically. No platform involved at any step.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Ebooks online

Stripe's decision not to support Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Kenya, Ethiopia, and dozens of other countries is not a technical limitation — it is a business decision driven by correspondent banking requirements, local regulatory compliance costs, and risk modeling. PayPal operates the same way. The practical result is that a creator in Lagos with a real product, a real audience, and a real income goal is blocked at the infrastructure level before any transaction ever occurs. Understanding this is the first step toward choosing a different architecture. The correct response is not finding a compliant workaround inside the conventional system. It is building on infrastructure that does not require banking partnerships, local regulatory agreements, or platform permission to operate. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails that bypass every one of these constraints.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture works by using a combination of free and paid tools to create a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. This is achieved through a stack of tools including GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments is used for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle are unavailable or severely restricted. These creators sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, software, and digital products, but cannot collect payment through conventional platforms. By providing a sovereign commerce infrastructure, COREMERCH empowers these creators to take control of their online stores and commerce stacks.
Digital creators in restricted countries can break free from platform limitations and take control of their commerce stacks with COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of the sovereign commerce infrastructure include the Edge Commerce Stack, which is a stack of tools that includes Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. This stack is designed to provide a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. Additionally, the infrastructure includes GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery.

By following these steps, creators can take control of their online stores and commerce stacks and start selling digital products online without relying on platforms like Stripe and PayPal.
